# `mise bootstrap settings status`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap settings status [--missing] [-J --json] [PLUGIN]…`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Show each setting in `[bootstrap.settings]` and its current value

## Arguments
- **`[PLUGIN]…`** — Plugins whose sections to show; all of them by default

## Flags
- **`--missing`** — Exit with status 1 if a setting differs from the config or its plugin cannot run
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
